scope: Bounded primary-action acceptance audit:9 specific findings,1 fixed+independently verified and8 remaining source/evidence gaps; not whole260 acceptance.
method: Inspected four contracts, source inventory, traceability/current evidence, all frontend test text for targeted handlers/selectors, plus concrete listed suites. Sourceinventory means discovery only. Reproduced New-group failure with real browser button against disposable fixture GETs.

safety.test_and_document_changes: This reviewer wrote one read-only browser test plus two evidence JSON files; no app source changes.

recognized_existing_evidence: Account creation/recovery3 responsive workflows already assert exact payload, failure draft retention, cancellation, role visibility, duplicate prevention and late completion; stale admin contract labels alone do not reopen those as missing.
Mapping editor and initial recovery already have Chromium/Firefox/WebKit exact assertions.
Normalized unit/reference create/save/structured validation/confirmed-save GET-only recovery and shared unload protections have focused recent evidence; not repeated here as missing.
Archive undo and recycle restore/purge have bounded browser outcomes, despite older pending labels.
Rota rules compare/restore and generation review/apply/reversal/publish have bounded browser outcomes; no blanket pending finding based on old inventory.

runtime_reproduction.action: real pointer click #new-call-cluster after populated form
runtime_reproduction.outcome: All3 retain same existing form; expected blank new form unmet.
runtime_reproduction.snapshot: Historical before root New-flow fix; does not describe final current behavior.

findings.prerequisites: At least one existing eligibility group; open #view=call-clusters.
findings.expected: New opens an empty Create Eligibility Group form with empty hidden id; subsequent reviewed submission creates rather than edits.
findings.existing_test_gap: No browser test references #new-call-cluster; admin contract explicitly runtime pending.
findings.next_acceptance: Empty-list and existing-list New; cancel/discard dirty edit; create exact payload and fresh GET; original group unchanged.
findings.observed_before_fix: Real New click retains existing id/name and Save Group label on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Handler nulls selection, renderer automatically selects first existing group again.
findings.current_outcome: Root added explicit createNew mode. Independent actual-app real clicks/keyboard in Chromium,Firefox,WebKit at320/1280 now reach empty id/name/description with Create Group and disabled Save Members. Opening existing row restores unchanged fields; second New works; reload shows original group. Zero mutation calls or page errors.
findings.remaining: Dirty-group discard/new disposition and exact create/save mutations remain unverified here; separate findings2/3 retain scope.

findings.prerequisites: Existing group selected or working New form after prior defect fix.
findings.expected: One explicit save sends exact existing payload, retains draft on failure, preserves immutable key for update, and cannot repaint another destination/account after delayed completion.
findings.observed: Handler has neither disabled-submit early return nor captured account/view guard; awaits mutation then unconditionally renderCallClusters. Accounts handler immediately above has both protections. This is source risk, not runtime reproduction of race.
findings.existing_test_gap: No browser test references createCallCluster/updateCallCluster or group save selector. No exact group mutation payload/runtime negative-outcome evidence located.
findings.next_acceptance: Held save plus Enter; 422/503 draft retention; confirmed save then failed read; navigation/signout while held; exact POST versus PUT and stable key.

findings.prerequisites: Existing group plus active same-call and wrong-call members.
findings.expected: Save Members updates exact intended group and selected member ids/effective dates once; filtered selections survive; disabled wrong-call choices stay unchanged; failures preserve choices.
findings.observed: Handler serializes checked inputs, awaits update then unconditionally rerenders. No disabled-submit or account/view guard; same source risk as group save.
findings.existing_test_gap: No runtime suite references Save Members selector or updateCallClusterMembers. Source contract pending.
findings.next_acceptance: Filtered/hidden checked members; explicit effective date; wrong-call disabled; duplicate activation; error retention; held completion after group switch/navigation/account reset.

selectors: past-duty host initial error state (no retry selector currently)
findings.prerequisites: Opening past-duty screen; either initial status or members GET fails.
findings.expected: Escaped descriptive alert with explicit read-only retry that mounts working controls, no import/save replay, and does not repaint abandoned screen.
findings.observed: Initial catch renders plain escaped panel text and returns. No alert role or retry action exists in this branch.
findings.existing_test_gap: Only member-management unit test mounts this module; its initial reads always succeed. Broad responsive screen checks are not error/retry outcomes.
findings.next_acceptance: Status failure and members failure independently; manual retry restores controls once; close/navigation before held read; keyboard focus and no writes.

findings.prerequisites: Reviewed valid preview; apply succeeds; subsequent getPastDutyStatus fails.
findings.expected: Keep confirmed saved/replayed outcome, explicitly distinguish failed GET refresh, offer read-only retry and never repeat import automatically.
findings.observed: Apply clears preview and sets success message, then awaits status in same try. Rejected GET overwrites success message with generic error in catch, losing visible confirmed-save outcome.
findings.existing_test_gap: Synthetic member-management test proves preview_hash and correction confirmation on successful happy path only; no actual browser apply or apply-success/read-failure test.
findings.next_acceptance: Mock exact reviewed FormData/hash; hold/apply duplicate prevention; successful apply then503 status; saved indicator survives; GET-only retry; replayed result and uncertain mutation distinguishable.

findings.prerequisites: Local .xls/.xlsx fixture with ambiguous member, correction, skip row and parser warning.
findings.expected: Inspect creates worksheet mapping; preview reflects selected sheet/header/month; choosing/undoing member or skip/include re-previews; changed input invalidates reviewed hash and confirmations; blocked apply sends no mutation.
findings.observed: Workflow exists in source, but real browser controls/keyboard/modal-free table/phone reflow not exercised in located tests.
findings.existing_test_gap: member-management.test.mjs uses fabricated host.innerHTML and calls host.onclick/onchange directly; it is useful serialized-state coverage but does not certify native file input, resolver action hit targets or browser rendering.
findings.next_acceptance: Real setInputFiles and pointer/keyboard at320/390/1280 in3 engines; exact FormData options; stale preview blocker; open Edit row retained; no accidental apply.

findings.prerequisites: Past-duty screen; rejected export additionally needs preview rows.
findings.expected: Native download event with unchanged expected filename/content; rejected rows correspond exactly to reviewed preview; errors recover without clearing file/preview.
findings.observed: Template uses Blob/object URL and detached anchor; rejected uses shared exporter. No browser download evidence for these controls located.
findings.existing_test_gap: Synthetic test asserts exporter delegation rows+filename only. No actual template/rejected download event or artifact-content assertion.
findings.next_acceptance: Capture downloads, verify filenames and existing-format fixture content without changing export semantics; repeated activation; failed template read; object URL lifecycle.

findings.prerequisites: Nonempty policy/version history and import batch rows.
findings.expected: Policy save preserves exact enabled/weights/effective-date contract and shows recoverable validation failure; View Rows loads exact batch and escapes source/normalized values without changing upload review.
findings.observed: Controls exist; no browser outcome assertions located. Policy fields are not inside native form, so min/max metadata alone does not prove pre-submit validation.
findings.existing_test_gap: Synthetic past-duty test supplies policy but never activates save-policy or past batch. Existing import-history tests target different member/operational imports.
findings.next_acceptance: Exact existing PUT body; nonfinite/out-of-range feedback using existing backend errors without changing policy rules; failure retains inputs; batchGET failure/retry and safe markup; switching batches cannot reveal stale rows.

findings.prerequisites: Mappings screen with existing unsaved mapping edits and source scan available.
findings.expected: One deliberate scan invokes existing API, refreshes resulting rows while retaining correct operator/destination context, clearly separates successful scan from failed readback, and retains drafts according to explicit existing policy.
findings.observed: Handler awaits scan then loadMappings and shows success. Existing guarded loader helps response ordering; scan operation itself has no captured destination/account in handler.
findings.existing_test_gap: premium-mappings tests cover editor save, failed save, exact payload/readback, search and initial load retry; no test references #scan-mappings. admin contract runtime pending.
findings.next_acceptance: Mock scan only, never actual production scan; exact request; repeat click; scan success/GET failure; navigation or signout while held; no mutation replay; explicit unsaved-edit disposition.

limitations: Only New group was exercised live by this review; all other findings explicitly classify source path or missing runtime evidence.
No backend validation/persistence certification; no production requests.
Physical devices and actual screen readers were not used.
Concurrent source changes after recorded hashes require targeted rerun; do not silently treat this as current after edits.
Older action-contract pending counts are known to lag recent evidence; findings were independently cross-checked instead of treating counts as failures.

post_fix_regression.scope: Existing-group New flow only; no create/save mutation certification.

followup_note: Historical source observations retained. Current bounded eligibility/past reports and36mapping scan workflows address their stated gaps; broader action/role/item acceptance still pending.
